capabilities: highlight note titles and aliases in Markdown, PDF, EPUB, Canvas, browser pages, and Zotero
show a hover card of the source note and open it on click
define multiple lightweight inline glossary entries in one Markdown file
review selected entries as FSRS note, question-answer, and cloze cards
save encountered sentences as occurrences and render relation or retention blocks
extras: The browser and Zotero companions are separate downloads installed manually (unpacked extension or XPI) and connect over a loopback bridge with a token; the interface supports English and Chinese; scanned PDFs without a text layer cannot be highlighted.
motivation: The author sees vocabulary as infrastructure: a constantly available lexicon that supports noticing and re-encounter, citing the extended-mind thesis and research on textual enhancement.
problem: Obsidian has no way to automatically highlight terms from your own notes and show their definitions while you read PDFs, EPUBs, web pages, or Zotero items.

relations.evidence: FSRS spaced repetition with note and occurrence-cloze cards
Zotero Reader through Lexis for Zotero

summary: Glossary plugin that turns note titles and aliases into highlighted, hover-defined terms across Markdown, PDF, EPUB, browser, and Zotero, with optional FSRS review.
